real: armoured 4x4 pickup (Land Cruiser 79 / Kozak-class conversion) carrying fibre-optic FPV drones
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p25_new / mb_p27_wave3): a 4x4 armoured pickup with an FPV rack and two cable spools; 4.6 x 1.9 x 2.0 m; team bands on both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the bonnet with its louvred grille and bull bar, lamps, tow hooks, wheel arches
the armoured four-door cab, windscreen, small thick windows, door seams, handles, mirrors, steps, roof hatch
four wheels on beam axles with leaf springs
the bed: tub, sides, tailgate, tail lamps, exhaust
the FPV launch rack on its turntable: four quadcopters with arms, rotors, charges and cameras (Turret)
the two fibre spools on their frame and the fibre runs
the mini-swarm launch box on the cab roof (the free secondary)
the operator's antenna mast, jerrycans, the spare wheel, a rolled net, Team bands
